title: FIGO CALLED A 2-2 CLASICO. REAL MADRID WON 2-1.
description:
He named four scorers. Only two of them scored. Welcome to the Figo forecast.

Luis Figo called a 2-2 Clasico. Reality disagreed. His four scorers were Raphinha, Yamal, Bellingham and Mbappe. Real Madrid won 2-1, Mbappe scored twice and Raphinha got one. Two out of four. Half right.

Figo also says that 26 years ago he could have started for either team. To be fair, he won the 2000 Ballon d'Or: football he gets, forecasts less so. And he said Mourinho could have been a good Barcelona coach. Bold, Luis. Very bold.

Mourinho at Barcelona: bold or bonkers? Tell us your take.
